deferred.title: CPS broader labor-underutilization rates U-4 to U-6
deferred.reason: Direct definitions page gives broader numerators and denominators involving discouraged/marginally attached people and part-time-for-economic-reasons workers. Valuable adjacent deterministic definitions, but require careful subset/disjointness accounting (discouraged is already part of marginally attached; part-time workers are employed). Continue this source next; do not substitute them into the unemployment numerator without changing meaning.

deferred.title: CPS annual rates or repeated monthly counts as person-flows
deferred.reason: Reference-week population levels are not hiring/separation flows and cannot be accumulated into unique annual persons by adding months. Annual average counts and ratio-of-averages conventions need their own source/time aggregation review; no time-series summation in current scalar format.

handoff.summary: Four CPS status definitions: civilian labor force, unemployment, participation, employment-population ratio. Named rates differ by actual numerator/denominator meaning and are not treated as interchangeable dimensionless ratios. Historical published checks use the 2024-11-01 release vintage with rounding propagation, plus independent synthetic rosters and boundaries. Earlier 15 model IDs remain intact.
gaps: CPS meanings/person count units and classification/reference-week metadata require extension; do not coerce weighted counts into arbitrary probabilities.
Published count/rate rounding handled explicitly; no survey-estimation method or uncertainty interval added.
Broader U-4/U-5/U-6 definitions remain in queue pending subset audit.
handoff.review_notes: Direct BLS definition/method pages (definitions modified 2026-05-22), archived 2024-11-01 Table A-1, and BLS copyright terms inspected 2026-11-01. Reviewed exactly which October column is seasonally adjusted; raw population footnote retained. All published counts converted from thousands to persons; expected rates kept as printed after percent-to-fraction conversion. Labor-force sum checks tolerate only justified rounding, not source sampling error. Independent rosters check numerator populations and zero/upper boundaries. Toolkit validation logs accompany bundle/ZIP; pending scientific review. Duplicate search includes b01-b04, supplied 37-record inventory and runtime snapshot only. Toolkit JSON validation passed: four models, 12 arithmetic references and 11 rejection cases, all requires-extension; final edit revalidated before packing.

models.title: CPS civilian labor force from employed and unemployed persons
models.summary: Definition of a mutually exclusive status union within the CPS population. A person-level status count at the reference period, with no claim about hiring/separation flows or equilibrium.

relationship.original_equation: Civilian labor force = employed persons + unemployed persons.
relationship.locator: Civilian labor force subsection; corroborated BLS How Government Measures Unemployment, Basic concepts
relationship.translation_notes: Introduced E,U,LF map source prose counts. Dimensions person+person=person. No percentage scaling or time integration. Mutually exclusive classifications and equal sample weights/coverage are required; duplicated persons would invalidate addition. Survey-weighted estimates can be nonintegers even though persons are individually counted once. The mathematical identity allows E=U=0; a subsequent unemployment rate would then be undefined. Published separately rounded components may miss rounded LF by 1000 persons without contradicting the definition.

models.inverse_notes: E=LF-U given LF,U and require LF>=U>=0; U=LF-E given LF,E and require LF>=E>=0. No denominators, unique scalar solutions. Roster check LF=11,U=3 recovers E=8; forward LF=11. Rounded national LF inversion may differ from a separately published component within source rounding bounds; no statistical estimation implied.

models.inverse_notes: U=u*LF for 0<=u<=1,LF>0; LF=U/u for u>0,U>0, retaining U<=LF. Check u=.25,LF=12 gives U=3; forward .25. At u=U=0 every LF>0 fits; u=0,U>0 incompatible.
